items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I could have gone with Shep Fields but I would have had to quit school.

ctx.x: I have a note here that you played with Ralph Flanagan and Jack Teagarden before you were even 20.
Yeah. I just got out of a high school for six months. I could have gone with Shep Fields but I would have had to quit school.
Oh. Is he the guy that did “The Bubble Theme?”
